title: Galigani 2020 · Tool observation and body landmarks
citation: Galigani et al. (2020). Effect of tool-use observation on metric body representation and peripersonal space. Neuropsychologia, 148, 107622.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.sequence: Group 1 is independently recruited from Group 2’s stationary PPS cohort. Balance active versus observation session order and test immediately before and after training in each of the two sessions.
published_method.placement: Fix the right forearm palm down, shoulder-aligned and 20 cm from body midline. Register the physical wrist and elbow while the participant is blindfolded. Hide the forearm and shoulders using a board and cloth and remove the eye covering.
published_method.training: The experimenter or participant uses a 100 cm rake to retrieve colored cubes during six active cue blocks with intervening breaks. In observation the experimenter acts in the participant’s first-person view while the participant holds a matching rake still.
published_method.response: The experimenter moves a retroreflective marker along the table. The participant calls stop and may request lateral or along-table corrections. Use the confirmed point from OptiTrack V120:TRIO with the Motive/MATLAB setup.
published_method.analysis: Compare perceived-to-actual landmark distance ratios across assessment and training. The distance ratio is dimensionless despite unit labels in the Results.

stimulus_type.value: Visible marker moved by the experimenter along a table over the occluded forearm.

source_provenance.value: OptiTrack V120:Trio and Motive 1.7.5, with a custom MATLAB R2018a recording script.

trajectory_count.gap: Body-landmark judgment has no audiovisual or tactile target paradigm.

trajectory_path.value: Marker travels along table's longitudinal axis. Participant may request corrections in both axes.
trajectory_path.gap: Exact initial marker coordinates and hand-movement speed unreported.

stimulus_duration.gap: No fixed marker movement duration or judgment deadline stated.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: 80 × 80 cm board and shoulder occlusion, retroreflective marker on wooden stick, OptiTrack and MATLAB.

condition_intermixing.value: Ten randomized trials for each of two landmarks per assessment.

blocked_or_random_order.value: Pre and post assessments for active and observational training. Training order balanced.

task_sequence_rules.value: Say stop when the marker reaches the perceived hidden landmark. Participant may request position adjustments.

baseline_timing.gap: Body-landmark judgment has no audiovisual or tactile target paradigm.

catch_trial_type.gap: Body-landmark judgment has no audiovisual or tactile target paradigm.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.gap: 10 repetitions per visual landmark, with no tactile SOA.

baseline_count.gap: Body-landmark judgment has no audiovisual or tactile target paradigm.

catch_count.gap: Body-landmark judgment has no audiovisual or tactile target paradigm.

block_count.gap: 2 assessments for each of 2 training conditions, excluding training blocks.

total_trial_count.gap: 2 landmarks × 10 judgments × 2 phases × 2 training conditions, excluding actual-position calibration.

implementation_gaps: Requires a calibrated optical marker and physical occlusion, manually guided marker recollection, and a verified two-visit behavioral training schedule.
Original coordinate-registration workflow, realized target order and per-trial point recordings are unavailable.
